name: GCP
attack_surface: Cloud Storage buckets, Service Account key files, metadata endpoints, Compute Engine firewall rules
common_misconfigurations: Exposed Service Account JSON key files
Publicly accessible Cloud Storage buckets (allUsers permissions)
validation_methods: Test credentials using gcloud auth activate-service-account
List storage files using gsutil ls
evidence_requirements: Raw logs showing project billing or instance lists access
false_positive_indicators: Disabled service accounts that cannot authenticate
Storage buckets returning Access Denied errors
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Exposed service account keys with Editor or Owner roles are critical.
